title: Hezbollah Continues Attacking IDF Troops Despite US-Iran Nuclear Deal
detail: The IDF reported that Hezbollah continued attacking Israeli troops in south Lebanon even as the United States announced a deal with Iran, indicating ongoing hostilities in the region despite diplomatic developments. The attacks underscore the persistent security situation along the Lebanon-Israel frontier independent of broader diplomatic frameworks.

media.caption: IDF troops in south Lebanon amid ongoing Hezbollah attacks

title: Hezbollah: Iran Pledged to Guarantee Israeli Military Withdrawal from Lebanon in US Talks
detail: Hezbollah stated that Iran pledged during negotiations with the United States to guarantee an Israeli military withdrawal from Lebanon. The announcement signals that the ongoing US-Iran diplomatic process has incorporated Lebanon's security situation as a key element, with Iran positioning itself as a guarantor for Israeli compliance.

media.caption: Destruction in southern Lebanon as diplomatic negotiations continue

title: Iran-US MOU Includes Enforcement Mechanism for Israeli Ceasefire Violations in Lebanon
detail: An Iranian official confirmed that the Iran-US Memorandum of Understanding includes a specific mechanism for monitoring and enforcing compliance with the Israeli ceasefire in Lebanon. The mechanism represents a formal framework through which ceasefire violations by Israel can be tracked and addressed within the broader diplomatic agreement.

media.caption: Southern Lebanon ceasefire monitoring under new Iran-US diplomatic framework
